The cylinder has been modified to hold a single explosive round capable of wreaking utter destruction. Powered by revolutionary fervor.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s Tech Rebuild can be charged without a Move Action. Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. When fired by a user without BODY 10+ or a Cyberarm, they suffer the Broken Arm Critical Injury if they didn’t have it already.

When charged, this weapon cannot fire or see through Cover, but does still halve SP (Round Up). Uses modified Explosive Ammunition (50eb per round) which also functions like Incendiary Ammunition and is still capable of being used to make Aimed Shots (Still has its -2 Attack Check penalty). All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions like an Explosive for the purposes of carrying damage to targets behind Cover.

Whenever this weapon inflicts a Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (10 Total). When fired by a user without BODY 10+ or a Cyberarm, they suffer the Broken Arm Critical Injury if they didn’t have it already.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
